description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (0.60 each), grants [Attach Fire 3 with Stacking], [Synchro Mode], [Damage Cap +10000], [Instant Cast 1] and [Duel Mode] to the user

description.name: Attach Fire 3 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Fire Level by 3 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Fire 3

description.name: Synchro Mode
description.text: Replaces the Attack and Defend commands

description.name: Duel Mode
description.text: After using two of Booya (Duel Mode) or Heel Drop, grants [Duel 4S Mode] if the character has 4S level 2 and 6S level 0, [Duel 6S Mode] if the character has 4S level 0 and 6S level 2, or [Duel 9S Mode] if the character has 4S level 1 and 6S level 1, removed after triggering, removed if the character hasn't [Synchro Mode]
